# Mini mPOS

> Free, open-source Android point of sale for Adyen terminals, tablets and phones.

Official merchant documentation. Start with Quick start to choose a connection guide, or Demo to try a sample sale.
Testing covers TEST validation and going live. Using Mini mPOS covers daily work; Payment options covers optional
workflows. Troubleshooting owns recovery. The setup helper generates encrypted QR codes locally; its own scripts
send no credentials and store no entered values.
